# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen in Volume 1, around seventeen in Volume 2, twenty in Volume 3, and twenty-three in Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v2 c25 P61](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0061), [v3 c30 P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 c4 P14](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0014)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c40 P64](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0064)</sub>
- **Rank:** Doctor  <sub>[v4 c5 P9](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0009)</sub>

- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall, handsome youth with wavy chestnut hair, mischievous light-brown or hazel eyes, and a broad, strong chin. By his twenties, he matures into a tall, broad-shouldered, open-faced man who resembles his father.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v3 c30 P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 c36 P38](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0038)_

## Personality

Hugh possesses a strong, independent, and hardworking nature, combined with a playful, mischievous streak. He exhibits great intelligence, ambition, and a dedicated focus on his medical aspirations. While friendly and popular among his peers, he displays a firm, determined stubbornness when pursuing his goals or standing by his convictions.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014), [v2 c14 P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 c30 P24](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0024)_

## History

After spending three years in Alberta during his childhood, Hugh returns to Brierley to resume his schooling at age fourteen. He initially clashes with Nell Harcourt when he teases her about her red hair, leading her to break a slate over his head, though he quickly apologizes. Throughout their school years, Hugh excels academically and competes closely with Nell, advancing through the fourth and fifth classes. He serves as the president of the Brierley Village Improvement Society, leading community projects such as raising funds to renovate the village hall. Hugh eventually attends Regent's Academy, where he qualifies for First Class studies alongside Nell, and later attends Wexcombe College. At Wexcombe, he is elected Freshman class football captain and earns High Honors in Classics along with the Cooper Prize. While in college, he proposes marriage to Nell, but she initially declines his offer. After graduation, Hugh takes over the medical practice of his great-uncle, Dr. David Carrow, in Seven Gulls Harbor. He survives a near-fatal bout of typhoid fever, during which Nell realizes her true feelings for him. Following his recovery, Hugh proposes to Nell again in Dinah Wren's garden, and she accepts. The two are married in the orchard at Grey Shutters, after which they settle into their new home in Seven Gulls Harbor and welcome their first child, James Obed.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c30 P20](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0020), [v3 c6 P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 c20 P30](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0030), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 c40 P10](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0010), [v3 c41 P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024), [v3 c41 P35](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0035), [v4 c1 P15](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0015), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v4 c5 P19](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0019), [v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021)_

## Background by volume

- Son of John Carrow
- Nephew of Mrs. Laurence Fletcher  <sub>[v4 c40 P23](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0023)</sub>
- Great-nephew of Dr. David Carrow  <sub>[v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)</sub>
- Spent three years living in Alberta as a child due to his father's illness  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
